WATCHno writing yetHow to answer a "Why...?" question

A "Why?" answer needs the real reason

Mia sat at the very back of the school bus every day, even though her friends sat at the front. The back seats were right next to the heater, and Mia hated the cold.

Question: Why does Mia always sit at the back of the bus?

Not a reason (no marks):
"Because she is Mia."
"Because she likes the back."
"She sits at the back every day."
A real reason:
Mia sits at the back because the back seats are next to the heater, and she hates the cold.
Check: ✓ use the question's words   ✓ because   ✓ the reason from the text, not just a description

WRITEfull sentences with "because"Set A: chapter 6
A1Why do the other boys not believe Stanley when he says he stole the sneakers?
They do not believe him because the sneakers belonged to ___, a ___ .
Who is "Sweet Feet"? Why would a kid like Stanley have his shoes?
They do not believe him because the sneakers belonged to Clyde "Sweet Feet" Livingston, a famous baseball player.
A2Why was the trial so painful for Stanley?
It was painful because Clyde Livingston was Stanley's ___, and now he thought Stanley was ___ .
Find "That was the worst part for Stanley." What was on his bedroom wall?
It was painful because Clyde Livingston was Stanley's hero, and now he thought Stanley was a "no-good-dirty-rotten thief" who stole from homeless children.
A3Why did nobody believe Stanley's story at the trial?
Nobody believed him because he said that ...
Nobody believed him because he said that the shoes fell from the sky, which sounded impossible. He told the truth, but it sounded like a lie.
Extension (early finishers): his mother said "Just tell the truth." Was that good advice? Why or why not?
WRITEfull sentences with "because"Set B: chapter 7 (first part)
B1Why does X-Ray always take the shortest shovel?
X-Ray takes the shortest shovel because each hole must be as ___ and as ___ as the shovel. So a shorter shovel means ___ .
How is each hole measured? Look back at Dig 5, question 2.
X-Ray takes the shortest shovel because each hole must be as deep and as wide as the shovel is long. So a shorter shovel means a smaller hole and less digging.
B2How does Stanley finally break into the hard ground?
He puts the shovel on ___ and then ___ .
He puts the point of the shovel on a thin crack in the ground and then jumps on the blade with both feet.
B3Mr Pendanski says the boys dig "to build character". Do you believe him? Back it up.
I do / don't believe him because he also says "___". This suggests that ...
What happens if the Warden likes what you find?
I don't believe him because he also says "If the Warden likes what you found, you'll get the rest of the day off." This suggests that the Warden is really looking for something buried in the lake.
Back It Up page: copy "___ because ___. So ___." This is your "Why?" frame.
WRITEin your Symbol Tracker (back of notebook)Symbol Tracker: smelly feet

A new symbol: smelly feet and shoes

SymbolChapterWhat it shows
Smelly feet / shoes3, 6Stanley's father is trying to recycle old ___ . Clyde Livingston's shoes were "anything but ___": they had a bad case of ___ . The shoes are the reason Stanley ___ .
sneakerssweetfoot odorwas sent to Camp Green Lake
Stanley's father is trying to recycle old sneakers. Clyde Livingston's shoes were "anything but sweet": they had a bad case of foot odor. The shoes are the reason Stanley was sent to Camp Green Lake.
Funny detail: his nickname is "Sweet Feet", but his shoes stink! Keep watching the shoes: they matter at the end.
